annotation.title_clean: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI: Ethically Aligned Design for Business
annotation.title_en: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI: Ethically Aligned Design for Business
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA business-committee paper arguing that responsible AI success should be measured by human well-being and planetary metrics (UN SDGs, ESG) rather than financial indicators alone. It offers an Assess/Apply/Amplify framework and a well-being metrics readiness table for organizations. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Organizations should define 'responsible' at the outset and across the AIS life cycle using expanded KPIs.
Well-being and sustainability metrics (UN SDGs, ESG) matter more than financial indicators.
Uses the IEEE Std 7010-2020 definition of well-being.
Assess, Apply and Amplify framework with a Well-Being Metrics Readiness Framework table.
Aimed at businesses, including SMBs, and informs policymakers.
